sentencesBefore: I've tracked the moisture loss of beef in my kitchen, and leaving a steak uncovered in the fridge for 24 hours removes up to 5% of its surface water weight, guaranteeing a violent, immediate sear.
Restaurants aggressively season their steaks with up to 30% more salt and fat than most home cooks are comfortable using.
sentencesAfter: In my kitchen, leaving a steak uncovered in the fridge for 24 hours dries the surface enough to sear violently — you can feel the difference the moment the meat hits the pan.
Restaurants season their steaks far more aggressively than most home cooks are comfortable using.
